title: Associations between plasma proteomic profiles and subclinical variations in left atrial strain in adults without overt cardiovascular disease: the role of cardiometabolic factors.
snippet: Associations between plasma proteomic profiles and left atrial strain (LAS) may provide insights into biological processes that underly variations in atrial function in adults without overt cardiovascular disease (CVD).
